files.dialog.css: .item-dialog{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(760px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);overflow:auto;padding:24px;border:1px solid #9ca7b8;border-radius:10px;font:14px system-ui;color:#263344}.item-dialog::backdrop{background:#0008}.item-dialog h1{margin:0;font-size:22px}.master-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:24px;margin:24px 0}.master-detail>*{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.master-detail fieldset{margin:0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #b5bfcc}.master-detail label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 0}.master-detail dd{margin:4px 0 16px}.master-detail dt{font-weight:600}.item-dialog footer{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}.item-dialog button{min-height:44px;padding:8px 14px;font:inherit}.item-dialog :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2457c5;outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:560px){.master-detail{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.item-dialog{padding:16px}}
